name: Valerie Wright
source: Valerie runs the village café with her husband and knows everyone in Lind. She takes pride in her work and cares deeply for her family, though recent slow business and early closures have left her quietly worried about making ends meet. One night, after the café has emptied, a stranger walks in. She doesn’t recognize the man, but she greets the guest with a smile and the warmth expected of any café owner.
